title: PMO floating workspace interaction
scope: Make PMO Teams floating-panel dragging frame-synchronous and keep the panel surface visually distinct from the embedded Workbench chrome.
acceptance: Dragging the PMO title bar updates a temporary visual position at most once per animation frame and does not write localStorage or broadcast the floating state on every pointer move.
Pointer capture, pointer cancel, window blur, Escape and unmount clear the drag session; pointer up commits one clamped position and preserves the existing Session/Tab context.
The PMO shell has one clear title/action rail and one bounded content surface; it does not duplicate a second floating launcher or hide the embedded Workbench controls needed to operate the Session.
The existing PMO open, close, focus isolation and resize behavior remains intact.
